contexts.text: It is permitted the celestial man to enjoy all these things; but not to possess them as his own. Signified.
No one is forbidden to enjoy... the pleasures of possessions of lands and wealth. Explained.
Possessor of heavens and earth () = the conjunction of the internal man, or Jehovah, with the interior and exterior man. AC 1746.
Before plenary conjunction... was effected (the Lord's internal man) is called Possessor of heavens and earth, that is, Possessor of all things which are with the interior and exterior man.
The internal man of the Angels is the Lord's possession...
The Lord's Kingdom, of which He alone is the Possessor. Signified.
To inherit the Land = to possess the heavenly Kingdom... But, as to the Divine Essence, He was the Possessor of the universe... from eternity.
For an eternal possession () = what is eternal. They are called possessors, and heirs, not from merit, but from mercy.
Those arriving from the Christian world (want) to possess all things.
So far as they can, they deprive (those who do not favour them) of their possessions, etc.
That they should possess the goods, etc., of the nations. Explained.

The (Hebrew) word which is predicated of good may be rendered to possess hereditarily... This word involves possession... as is the case with the Celestial... In this verse... the word denoting possession by hereditary right is used; because the Lord's Divine Human is the sole Heir Possessor. Illustrated.
That to possess hereditarily... when predicated of men, = to receive life from the Lord, consequently... Heaven. Illustrated.
To possess hereditarily is here predicated of those in celestial love...
To possess () is predicated of celestial good. AC 2712:4.
Is not the happiness... in possession, honour, etc.?
Want to possess the goods of all. AC 3175.
Give me possession of a sepulchre () = that they can be regenerated.
Before regeneration, he is possessed by diabolical Spirits...
Possess ye in the land () = to make a one, thus, to agree together.
Wants to possess the universal world...
When they have entered into the taste, they possess the man's interiors... Very many are at this day possessed by these Spirits; for there are now interior obsessions... AC 4793:3.
They aim to be worshipped as gods, the possessors of Heaven and earth.
In spiritual life there are... no other possessions and inheritances than the felicities of life which are from goods and the derivative truths.
The possession of scientifics. Signified.
For he who gives possession, gives its good; and conversely.
Possession () = good.
He gave them a possession in the land of Egypt () = ... a fixed state of spiritual life in the natural mind. AC 6171.
As Spirits possess all things of man's thought and will, and Angels the things still more interior...
Therefore the Spirits who enter into the very affections, possess another...
When I have thought inordinately about possessions, etc., I have relapsed into the Sensuous... and was removed from consort with the Angels. Explained.
(To show me how the prophets) were acted upon... I was for a whole night possessed by Spirits. Described.
An eternal possession () = to have the Lord's life.
Their possession in the Lord's Kingdom while they are as yet in obscurity. Signified, Explained.
When the cupidity of... possessing the goods of others invaded the mind...
These desire to possess all things which are the neighbour's...
Thou hast possessed () = who have thus become the Lord's.
With these, universally reigns... the desire of possessing all things...
That those in goods and truths from the Lord possess nothing of good and truth from themselves... Signified. Goods and truths from self... are signified by to possess gold, silver, etc. ().
Everyone by birth wants... to possess the goods of others... AC 10814:2.
The spiritual degree is closed with those who from the love of the world are in the insane cupidity of possessing the goods of others...
Satan is the love of possessing the goods of others by every evil art.
He would want to possess Heaven itself.
The love of possessing wealth beyond their necessities also entered...
He who wants to dominate over all things, also wants to possess all things.
See Love of the World.
Wants to possess the wealth of the world...
That they may alone possess the goods of the whole world. Treated of.
The love of possessing all things of the world, is Satan...
He that overcometh shall possess hereditarily all things () = that (such) will come into Heaven, and, then, into the possession of the goods which are there from the Lord...

The universals of Hell are... the love of possessing the goods of others from the love of the world... The universals of Heaven opposite to these are... the love of possessing the goods of the world from the love of doing uses by means of them...
Those in the concupiscence and thence in the phantasy of possessing the things of the world. Treated of, From experience. CL 268.
They take possession of them at their pleasure.
From having in possession...
For the possessions of goods in the world is nothing but what is imaginary...
Such want to possess men, even their bodies... SE 2665. SE 4910:end.
I can be possessed by Spirits, yet without injury...
Such is the world now that when anyone is possessed he at once incurs the peril of his life...
He then possessed my hand...
When they possess this province (around the left ear), they possess the Spirit or man. Explained. SE 5569:2.
When they lamented... concerning the loss of their possessions...
Concerning... the love of possessing the goods of the world. General article.
(If Spirits knew where men are) they would... make them possessed, as formerly.
To possess the reins () = to know the falsities and truths with man. ( = to purify truths from falsities. AE 710:16.)
The love of possessing goods from the mere delight of possession... stores up in it all evils. Explained.
